spec.query: SELECT "contract_error", "is_buy", "pre_fill_unix_ns"/1000000 AS "pre_fill_unis_ms", "pool", "base_asset_variant" AS "base", "quote_asset_variant" AS "quote", "expected_spread_bps" AS "exp spread bp", "realized_spread_bps" AS "rlzd spread bp", "gas_actual_fee_bps" AS "gas bps", "lot_size_usd", "fill_size_usd", "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp fill pnl", "is_cefi_trigger" AS "cefi trig", "is_defi_trigger" AS "defi trig", "edge_bps", "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", "tx_block", "version", "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_micros"  / 1000 AS "ms since block", "block_adjustment_bps_pre_fill" AS "block adj bp", "ema_adjustment_bps_pre_fill" AS "ema adj bp", "gas_usage_pct", "tx_hash"  FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Right now this is in active development stage, so it's entirely possible that I stopped the strategy to experiment. So don't get concerned if availability is 0 for some time! :)

spec.query: SELECT "alive" FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("stage"::tag = 'prod') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "network"::tag, "dex"::tag, "pool"::tag, "wallet_account"::tag, "mode"::tag LIMIT 1

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "strategy"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "strategy"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "contract_error"::tag = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(median("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "strategy"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "contract_error"::tag = '1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT last("pnl")
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE "strategy"::tag =~ /^$placement$/ 
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1s) 
fill(previous)

SELECT median("defi_base_balance_whole_pre_fill") FROM "default_defi_retention"."rust_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "base_asset"::tag =~ /^$asset$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "pool"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT last("positionAsFloat") * (last("bid") + last("ask"))/2
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ("strategy"::tag =~ /^$placement$/)
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) 
fill(previous)

SELECT median("defi_gas_balance_usd_pre_fill") FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "pool"::tag fill(previous)
